description: Scuba Diving prepares you to dive safely: first aid and CPR for diving conditions, the Swimming merit badge as a prerequisite, the Scuba Diver’s Code, earning an open water certification, aquatic ecosystems, and careers in the scuba industry.

safety.note: Scuba training happens only with a certified instructor through a recognized agency, following Scouting America’s scuba policy.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. The Swimming merit badge must be earned before requirements 3 through 6, and requirement 4 is earned through a recognized scuba certification agency.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)
